title: Cybermania
description: The world is being invaded by Machines! Can you Survive?
body:
# Cybermania

## The machines have turned! 
Scavenge salvage from wrecked Robots, forge new tools from their remains, and survive a war against an army of autonomous drones, artillery rigs, and mechanical juggernauts.

**New Resources & Crafting:**
- Defeat machine enemies to harvest salvaged components, alloy plating, power cores, servo parts, and more. Combine them to build machine-forged tools and weapons that surpass vanilla gear in power and functionality.

**Some Hostile Units:**
- **The Flea** — A nimble scout drone that harasses with rapid light-caliber fire. Fast, fragile, and found in swarms.
- **The Talon** — A larger aerial hunter that charges and releases high-voltage lightning bursts at ground targets.
- **The Bison** — Fires volleys of homing missiles that track the player. High threat. Prioritize or evade.
- **The Hammerhead** (Bossfight) — A titanic mobile harvesting platform. Summons waves of drone reinforcements to protect itself as its hull is breached. The fight escalates — the longer it runs, the worse it gets.

More units and features coming soon!
